title: fix: let MCP transcribeAudio fetch source audio on Workers
author: danhquach
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #15657

Fixes #15460

- Cloudflare Workers reject `fetch(..., { redirect: "error" })` ("error" won't be implemented since it does not make sense at the edge), so the hosted `transcribeAudio` threw on every source URL and reported "Could not fetch source audio".
- Fetches the source with `redirect: "manual"` and rejects any 3xx (or opaque redirect) with a clear message, so redirects stay blocked as before.
- Tests: asserts the source fetch uses `manual`, and adds a redirect-rejection case. Both new assertions fail on the old code.
- Verified: `packages/mcp` 7/7 and `apps/mcp` 8/8 tests, Biome clean, Worker dry-run build. Ran the built worker in local workerd (Miniflare) with the repo's compatibility flags: the old build fails with "Could not fetch source audio", and the fixed build returns the transcript for a direct public URL and rejects a redirecting one.

gist.headline: The hive can hear again
gist.blurb: Hosted audio transcription can fetch its source audio again. Direct URLs get transcripts; redirects still get a polite no.
gist.summary: Fixed hosted MCP transcribeAudio on Cloudflare Workers by fetching source audio with redirect: "manual" instead of unsupported redirect: "error", while continuing to reject redirects.
gist.impact: Direct public audio URLs now produce transcripts through the hosted MCP tool instead of failing with “Could not fetch source audio”; redirecting URLs remain blocked with a clear message.
